diagnoses.description: Date disambiguation failure: the pipeline likely selected a secondary date-like token (or OCR-corrupted label line) instead of the primary header date. Receipts/invoices can contain multiple date-like strings (header date, print date, closed date, etc.), and naive “first regex match” can pick the wrong one.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 034.jpg date_correct=false while amount_correct=true. The image shows a clear header date field (e.g., “Date: 09/03/2018”), but other date-like strings can appear elsewhere or be OCR-mutated (e.g., DATE→DATA). The current generic OCR skill does not emphasize label-tolerant date selection and top-of-receipt preference strongly enough to prevent this failure mode.

locations.section: Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Date extraction (reduce false positives)

diagnoses.description: Total selection failure due to OCR digit flip/outlier and competing ‘total’ variants: the model selected an implausible total-like number (e.g., 702.00) instead of the payable/rounded total (e.g., 102.00). This happens when OCR corrupts one line and the extractor lacks an outlier rejection / rounded-total preference.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 074.jpg amount_correct=false while date_correct=true. The receipt contains multiple total-related lines (Total excl/incl GST, Total Amt Rounded, Payment, GST Summary). OCR can misread 102.00 as 702.00; without a plausibility check and explicit preference for “Total Amt Rounded/Total Rounded” over “Total incl GST” when inconsistent, the wrong value is chosen.

locations.section: Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Total amount extraction (avoid subtotals/cash/change)

diagnoses.description: Rounding-line precedence failure: the extractor chose ‘Total (Inclusive of GST)’ instead of the final payable ‘TOTAL:’ after a rounding adjustment, causing an exact-match miss (often by 0.01).
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 077.jpg amount_correct=false while date_correct=true. The image shows a rounding adjustment line (e.g., “Rounding Adj: -0.01”) followed by a bold final “TOTAL: 23.25”, while an earlier line shows “Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26”. The skill guidance needs an explicit rule to prefer the final total after rounding when present.

locations.section: Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Total amount extraction (avoid subtotals/cash/change)

diagnoses.description: Output normalization failure: total_amount was emitted as an empty string instead of null (on failure) or a two-decimal string (on success). This violates the task’s strict schema and causes exact-match failure even if OCR found the number.
diagnoses.evidence: Allowed feedback: 078.jpg amount_correct=false; predictions table shows total_amount="". Task spec requires null on extraction failure and exactly two decimals when present. The skill docs should explicitly forbid empty strings and require strict post-processing/validation.

locations.section: Field Extraction Heuristics (Receipts) / Amount string normalization (critical for exact-match scoring)

quality_impact.rationale: The update targets the observed failure modes: (1) date ambiguity via label-tolerant ranking and top-of-receipt preference; (2) total confusion via explicit rounding precedence and GST-summary exclusion; (3) OCR digit-flip/outlier mitigation; (4) strict output normalization (null vs empty string, two decimals). These are likely to improve exact-match accuracy on hard receipts without degrading easy cases.

trigger_precision.rationale: Guidance is scoped to receipt OCR and the specific fields required by the task (date, total). It avoids prescribing a single OCR configuration globally and instead recommends a small, standard set of PSM/preprocess variants and field-level selection rules.

instruction_compliance.rationale: Diagnoses rely only on permitted evidence (field-level correctness feedback, predictions, and visible images) and do not reference oracle values. Only the changed SKILL.md file is provided as a complete replacement; other skills are left untouched.

solution_path_coverage.rationale: Covers the main error classes seen in the run: wrong date among multiple candidates, wrong total due to GST summary/rounding, OCR digit flips, and schema/formatting violations. Does not attempt broader enhancements (deskew/cropping) not implicated by the provided failures.

skillaxe_evaluation.overall_rationale: The original skills were generic OCR guides and did not encode receipt-specific disambiguation and strict output formatting required by exact-match scoring. A minimal, transferable improvement is to strengthen the image-ocr skill with receipt-oriented candidate ranking for dates, robust total selection (including rounding precedence and GST-summary handling), plausibility checks against OCR outliers, and explicit null/2-decimal normalization rules.

iteration_summary: Diagnosed four field-level failures (034 date; 074/077/078 totals) and updated only environment/skills/image-ocr/SKILL.md to add receipt-specific date ranking, total selection with rounding precedence and GST-summary exclusions, outlier rejection for OCR digit flips, and strict output normalization (two decimals or null; never empty string).
